WITH source_sums AS (
  SELECT source, SUM(amount) AS source_sum
  FROM income
  GROUP BY source
),
total_sum AS (
  SELECT SUM(source_sum) AS total
  FROM source_sums
),
paired AS (
  SELECT s.source_sum, s.source_sum / t.total AS share
  FROM source_sums AS s
  CROSS JOIN total_sum AS t
  WHERE t.total IS NOT NULL
),
average_sum AS (
  SELECT AVG(source_sum) AS avg_source_sum
  FROM paired
),
kept AS (
  SELECT p.source_sum, p.share, a.avg_source_sum
  FROM paired AS p
  CROSS JOIN average_sum AS a
  WHERE a.avg_source_sum IS NOT NULL
    AND p.source_sum > a.avg_source_sum
)
SELECT AVG(source_sum) AS average_kept_source_sum,
       AVG(share) AS average_kept_share_of_total,
       AVG(source_sum - avg_source_sum) AS average_excess_over_average
FROM kept
